title: Fulfillment & Delivery
note: Computed by checks_dashboards_demo.py from the frozen .psv rows, with the same definitions truths.out uses. Each value carries the SQL it came from; Phase B2 holds every widget to these numbers.

kpis.label: On-time delivery %
kpis.sql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(CASE WHEN o.delivered_ts::DATE <= o.promised_date THEN 1 END) / count(*), 2) FROM dash_demo.orders o WHERE o.delivered_ts IS NOT NULL AND o.delivered_ts >= DATE '2026-07-02' AND o.delivered_ts < DATE '2026-09-30' + INTERVAL 1 DAY

kpis.label: Average days to deliver
kpis.sql: SELECT round(avg(date_diff('day', o.order_ts::DATE, o.delivered_ts::DATE)), 2) FROM dash_demo.orders o WHERE o.delivered_ts IS NOT NULL AND o.delivered_ts >= DATE '2026-07-02' AND o.delivered_ts < DATE '2026-09-30' + INTERVAL 1 DAY

kpis.label: Late orders
kpis.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM dash_demo.orders o WHERE o.delivered_ts IS NOT NULL AND o.delivered_ts >= DATE '2026-07-02' AND o.delivered_ts < DATE '2026-09-30' + INTERVAL 1 DAY AND o.delivered_ts::DATE > o.promised_date

kpis.label: On-time delivery %
kpis.sql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(CASE WHEN o.delivered_ts::DATE <= o.promised_date THEN 1 END) / count(*), 2) FROM dash_demo.orders o WHERE o.delivered_ts IS NOT NULL AND o.delivered_ts >= DATE '2026-07-02' AND o.delivered_ts < DATE '2026-09-30' + INTERVAL 1 DAY AND o.carrier IN ('SwiftPost')

density.bucket: country with a rate, deliveries in the period
density.rule: a rate per country on a map: 60 deliveries per coloured country; below that the country has no rate and stays uncoloured
density.sql: SELECT coalesce(min(n), 0) FROM (SELECT count(*) AS n FROM dash_demo.orders o WHERE o.delivered_ts IS NOT NULL AND o.delivered_ts >= DATE '2026-07-02' AND o.delivered_ts < DATE '2026-09-30' + INTERVAL 1 DAY GROUP BY o.country_code HAVING count(*) >= 60)
